*Side · Cards & Mobs*

There are no natural animals on the island. Instead, most sifting tables drop **card packs** at small chances. Open a pack for cards, and craft mob cards into **spawn eggs**.
Common packs hold the farm animals; rare packs hold villagers and the Allay (whose cards also make plastic). This chapter can be done any time after you have a sifter.
Smelting an uncommon pack gives a **nether pack**, the route to wither skeletons and the Wither, whose nether star powers the Flight Anchor.

book.quicreate.skyblock.creative.intro.o:
*Endgame · Creative*

Everything comes together. Cursium, ignitium, witherite and essence of the storm make the **creative alloy**.
Sixteen loops of sequenced assembly (cryo fuel, ice crystal, sturdy sheets and pressing) make the **creative sheet**, which goes on a block of enderite for the creative casing.

The **Mechanical Fusion Anvil** turns a rotation speed controller and a blaze cake into the creative motor and the creative blaze cake.

Finishing the casing, motor and cake (and the dragon) completes the pack: the true ending.
book.quicreate.skyblock.creative.intro.s: Sturdy sheets are powdered obsidian and lava in sequenced assembly. Enderite is netherite + void core + void steel; four ingots compact into the block the casing needs.
The creative alloy is mixed superheated from the four boss materials plus iron.

book.quicreate.skyblock.field.about_this:
*Click for details and motivation!*

**This is a Skyblock Modpack based around rapid expandable progression.**

I wanted a skyblock modpack you could sit down, feel progression in, and "complete" your first time in around 10 hours without a plan. Then after that, optimize your pathing and get faster on future playthroughs.
The intial end goal is to beat the Ender Dragon of course, but strongholds only spawn on the moon! You will need to build a Rocket and make your way there to win the game.

Also on the moon is an optional boss and new materials which can be used to access new technology, rockets, and weapons.

You'll be able to travel to more distant planets, finding new bosses to defeat and more materials to improve your factory.

The defeat of the Ender Dragon is the soft ending, but the true ending is access to the /5/Creative/5/ factory components which will require defeating the bosses of every planet and a robust automated factory.
Inventory is kept on death by default because I think it's a artificial difficulty in skyblock. Maybe you think it's not, this can be changed in the config.
book.quicreate.skyblock.field.ad_astra.r:
*Core Mod 1: Space*

Ad Astra is the modern space travel mod, comparable to Galacticraft or whatever was in tekkit.

I wanted to try this mod the moment I found it, but it had the issue every space mod has - every planet is mostly empty, and you have no reason to engage with it beyond the intrinsic fun of making a rocket.
This is a core mod because I wanted to make it relevant to late game progression to make it feel worth using, rather than adding it as a kitchen sink style addition.
Planets have currently been improved somewhat with some generation and structures, and making the resources found on each planet critical to tech advancement.
book.quicreate.skyblock.field.assembly.c: Circuits are made on a belt with deployers, a press and a saw, in loops. Each tier is built from the one below it.
Costs multiply as you climb. One ancient metal circuit is about **288 redstone** and **144 quartz**. Leave each line running.
book.quicreate.skyblock.field.bosses.a.p:
Each world has bosses. Their drops make the next tier of gear, and the creative ending needs four of them.

Bring food, armour and a way home. The Bestiary side path has a page for every boss.
book.quicreate.skyblock.field.cards.a.p0:
Most sifting tables drop card packs at small chances. Open a pack for cards.

Mob cards craft into **spawn eggs**: that is how animals reach the island.
book.quicreate.skyblock.field.cards.a.p1:
Common packs hold farm animals. Rare packs hold villagers. Smelt an uncommon pack for a nether pack.

A deployer holding shears opens packs for you.

See the [Cards & Mobs](entry://quicreate:skyblock/cards/card_packs) side path.
book.quicreate.skyblock.field.cards.name: Card packs
*Core Mod 3: Boss Fights*

Cataclysm adds great boss fights and more materials to add more angles of progression.
The bosses are scattered across several planets to let you make tech advancements with combat rather than just exploration and mining.
book.quicreate.skyblock.field.cobble_gen: Lava flowing next to water makes cobblestone. Mine it, and it comes back.
Water on one side, lava on the other, mine the middle.

The [Mechanical Extruder](item://create_mechanical_extruder:mechanical_extruder) does this automatically, and the block under it picks the stone. See [Mechanical Extruder](entry://quicreate:skyblock/new_age/mechnanical_extruder).
book.quicreate.skyblock.field.create_cat: *Add creative resources accessible near the end*
Create: Cataclysm gives us the the end game goal. After total planetary travel is achieved and every boss slain, you can craft the Creative Tier items for maximum factory convenience and potential.
book.quicreate.skyblock.field.create_new:
*Core Mod 2: Electricity*

Create: New Age was the first mod I found and I used it on its own in a regular world and liked it a lot!
I made it a core mod because I think the physical nature of the power generation, and heat generation, this mod adds novel and unique.
book.quicreate.skyblock.field.electricit: A [Generator Coil](item://create_new_age:generator_coil) makes power while it spins and touches [Magnetite Block](item://create_new_age:magnetite_block). Up to 12 magnets per coil.
Stronger magnets give more power for the same rotation: redstone, layered, then fluxuated magnetite.
[Carbon Brushes](item://create_new_age:carbon_brushes) on the end of the coil collect the power. [Electrical Connector](item://create_new_age:electrical_connector) carry it with wire.
The coil is a 5x5 recipe: build this grid.

*1.3 · Improvements*

This chapter builds the parts every later machine and rocket uses: **steel**, **motors** and the **circuit ladder**.
Circuits are made by sequenced assembly, and each tier is built from the one below it (blank → copper → emerald, then amethyst and ancient metal on the planets), so the cost multiplies as you go up.
It also adds **nuclear heat**: a reactor gives heat at night, when the solar plates stop.
Improvements
Steel is iron and charcoal in a **superheated** mixer, so it needs a strong heat setup. Motors put rotation anywhere from electricity; motor extensions multiply their output.

Better magnets also make the generator coil more efficient.

**Plastic** comes from compacting card bits (sawn Allay cards) with blaze powder in a heated basin, or from mixing oil with blaze powder when superheated.

A **blank circuit** is an overcharged golden sheet with copper wire and plastic.

Copper circuits add overcharged iron wire and quartz over 3 loops; emerald circuits add electron tubes and copper circuits to an emerald wafer, also over 3 loops.

The reactor is built from reactor casing; each rod must be covered on every side by reactor parts, and the heat vents export the heat (or it builds up).

book.quicreate.skyblock.mars.intro.overv:
*Chapter 3 · Mars*

Mars has **ostrum** (only here), diamonds as ore, and **ancient debris** in the Mars rock at Y 90 to 130.
Netherite and ancient metal from the **Ancient Remnant** (Cursed Pyramid) lead to the ancient metal circuit, the ostrum engine and the **netherite space suit**, which Venus and Mercury require.

The netherite suit is the big cost of this chapter: four netherite ingots on full diamond armour, plus four upgrade templates (eight netherrack around a diamond).

Start collecting diamonds and debris early.

book.quicreate.skyblock.mars.intro.s2.p0: The reinforced motor uses sturdy casing (a sturdy sheet on brass casing). The three optional machines here automate mobs and chunk loading.

- Koboletons and wadjets in the desert site and desert village drop ancient metal nuggets, another route to ancient metal.

book.quicreate.skyblock.moon.intro.overv:
*Chapter 2 · The Moon*

The Moon has the only stronghold in the pack, so the soft ending happens here: find it with eyes of ender, go through the portal and kill the Ender Dragon.
It also has **desh**, the first space metal, and three mobs worth farming: **star crawlers** (a diamond every kill), **endermen** (ender pearls) and **amethyst crabs**.
Back home, desh plates make the **advanced brass mesh**, which turns your sifters into a source of diamonds, emeralds, lapis and the planet metals.
book.quicreate.skyblock.moon.intro.s0.p0: Twelve eyes of ender need twelve pearls and blaze powder. The Ruined Citadel is a fortress on the lunar wastelands with ender golems (void cores) and the optional Ender Guardian boss.
book.quicreate.skyblock.moon.intro.s1.p0: Moon cobblestone can come from the extruder (moon cobblestone below), and milled into moon sand it can be sifted with the advanced mesh. Ice shards energised at 10,000 energy become etrium.
book.quicreate.skyblock.moon.intro.s2.p0: Amethyst circuits sit on top of emerald circuits and need overcharged diamond wire. They go into the desh engine, the chunk loader and the smart crafter.
book.quicreate.skyblock.moon.intro.s2.p1: Etrium makes the etrionic capacitor and core, used on Mars and later.
book.quicreate.skyblock.moon.intro.s2.ti: Moon tech and the tier 2 rocket
- Moon ores: desh (Y −80 to 80), ice shards (Y −32 to 32), iron, and cheese. The full Moon page is in the Field Guide.
- Ender golems in the Ruined Citadel always drop a void core. Void cores are needed again later (spawners, enderite).

book.quicreate.skyblock.new_age.intro.ov:
*1.2 · New Age*

Blaze burners are out of reach in this pack, so heat comes from **Create: New Age**: solar heating plates and heaters, moved around with heat pipes and pumps.
Heated mixing makes **brass**, which unlocks the brass mesh, brass casing and the Mechanical Extruder.

The second half of the chapter is **electricity**: a Generator Coil spun while touching magnetite makes power, carbon brushes take it out, and an Energiser uses it to make overcharged metals and blaze powder.
book.quicreate.skyblock.new_age.intro.s0: The mechanical press needs a **block of iron** (81 iron nuggets), which is the first real grind: keep the sand sifters running. Pressing ingots on a depot or belt gives sheets, and a mechanical saw cuts copper sheets into wire.
book.quicreate.skyblock.new_age.intro.s1: Solar heating plates collect heat in daylight and a heater turns it into heat for the basin above it. Heat pipes and pumps move heat from the plates to where you need it, and a Stirling engine turns spare heat into rotation.
Heated mixing makes brass; superheated mixing (more heat) turns cobblestone into lava.
book.quicreate.skyblock.new_age.intro.s2: Copper and zinc in a heated mixer make brass. Now go back and make the **brass mesh** ([Brass Mesh](entry://quicreate:skyblock/sifting/brass_mesh)) and finish the brass-mesh sifting quests in the Sifting chapter.
book.quicreate.skyblock.new_age.intro.s3: The extruder makes a block forever from lava and water beside it. With nothing special below it makes stone; the **block underneath** changes the output and is never used up.

Put a block of iron, copper, zinc or gold under it to get Create's ore stones, then crush those for crushed ores. This is the end of the nugget grind. The full list of catalysts is in the Field Guide.
The Mechanical Extruder and Create ores
book.quicreate.skyblock.new_age.intro.s4: The Generator Coil is a 5×5 mechanical crafting recipe, so you need 21 mechanical crafters, and each crafter needs an electron tube (polished rose quartz on an iron sheet; rose quartz is quartz + 8 redstone).

Spin the coil while it touches up to 12 magnetite blocks; stronger magnets make more power for the same rotation.

Carbon brushes on the end of the coil take the power out, and connectors carry it to the Energiser.
book.quicreate.skyblock.new_age.intro.s5: The Energiser charges items with stored power. Overcharged iron and gold feed the circuits in the next chapter, and energised gunpowder is the pack's blaze powder.

The deployer opens up sequenced assembly, starting with the precision mechanism.

- [Overcharged Iron](entry://quicreate:skyblock/electricity/overcharged_iron)
- [Overcharged Gold](entry://quicreate:skyblock/electricity/overcharged_gold)
- [Blaze Powder](entry://quicreate:skyblock/electricity/blaze_powder)
- [Deployer](entry://quicreate:skyblock/new_age/deployer)
- [Precision Mechanism](entry://quicreate:skyblock/new_age/precision_mechanism)
book.quicreate.skyblock.new_age.intro.ti:
- Solar heat only works in daylight. Nuclear heat in the next chapter is the night-time answer.
- [Blaze Burner](entry://quicreate:skyblock/new_age/blaze_burner) only catches a burner made outside the intended route. You don't need one.

book.quicreate.skyblock.sifting.intro.ov: Sifting is how you get almost every raw material on the island. The chain is always the same: **mill** cobblestone into gravel, gravel into sand and sand into dust, then put those blocks through a **Sifter** holding a **mesh**.
Each block gives different drops, and each better mesh (string → andesite → zinc → brass → advanced brass) unlocks better ones.
A **waterlogged** sifter has its own drop tables: saplings and seeds from dirt, rubber, slime and clay from sand. Every table with its chances is in the Field Guide.
book.quicreate.skyblock.sifting.intro.s0: Everything from here on needs rotation. Start with the hand crank, then a water wheel on flowing water.

A windmill is the big early power source: windmill sail frames need no wool and stick without glue, and every 8 sails adds power and speed.

- [Hand Crank](entry://quicreate:skyblock/sifting/hand_crank)
- [Water Wheel](entry://quicreate:skyblock/sifting/water_wheel)
- [Windmill Bearing](entry://quicreate:skyblock/sifting/windmill_bearing)
- [Sails](entry://quicreate:skyblock/sifting/sails)
book.quicreate.skyblock.sifting.intro.s1: A millstone turns cobblestone into gravel, gravel into sand and sand into dust. Milling saplings gives string, which you need for the first mesh.
book.quicreate.skyblock.sifting.intro.s2: Each mesh is made from the one before it, so you climb the ladder in order. The brass mesh needs brass ingots, which only arrive in the New Age chapter ([Brass](entry://quicreate:skyblock/new_age/brass)), so plan to come back for it.
The sifter and the mesh ladder
book.quicreate.skyblock.sifting.intro.s3: The early metals all come as nuggets, so these quests ask for 27 (three ingots' worth). Iron and zinc come from sand, copper from gravel, redstone from dust.
The rare ones at the end (thorium, emeralds) are needed in chapter 1.3, so leave a brass-mesh sifter running on gravel and sand.
book.quicreate.skyblock.sifting.intro.ti:
- The block you sift is the input; the mesh sits inside the sifter.
- This chain feeds the whole early game. Put the millstones and sifters on belts as soon as you can and let them run.
- Card packs drop from most sifting tables at low chances; see the Cards & Mobs side chapter.

book.quicreate.skyblock.sky.intro.name: The Sky: start here
book.quicreate.skyblock.sky.intro.overvi:
*Chapter 1 · The Sky*

You start on a small island in an endless ocean: grass and dirt, one oak tree, and a chest with a single **lava bucket**. That lava is the most valuable thing you own.
Placed next to water it becomes your first cobblestone generator, and cobblestone is the raw material for almost everything in the first two chapters.

The goal of this chapter is a steady supply of wood and cobblestone, then **andesite alloy**, the material every early Create part is made from.

In this pack andesite alloy uses **charcoal**, so a furnace burning logs comes early.
book.quicreate.skyblock.sky.intro.s0.p0: Chop the tree, replant the saplings and keep a few spare: they become string later ([String](entry://quicreate:skyblock/sifting/string)). Build the cobblestone generator straight away (lava flowing next to water), because the next chapter mills a lot of it.
book.quicreate.skyblock.sky.intro.s0.p1:
Andesite here is crafted from cobblestone, and charcoal comes from smelting logs.

- [Logs](entry://quicreate:skyblock/sky/vein_mine_logs)
- [Saplings](entry://quicreate:skyblock/sky/saplings)
- [Get Crafting Table](entry://quicreate:skyblock/sky/get_crafting_table)
- [Cobblestone](entry://quicreate:skyblock/sky/cobblestone)
- [furnace](entry://quicreate:skyblock/sky/furnace)
- [andesite](entry://quicreate:skyblock/sky/andesite)
- [Charcoal](entry://quicreate:skyblock/sky/charcoal)
book.quicreate.skyblock.sky.intro.s1.p0: These quests only need to be ticked. They explain the idea of the pack: a skyblock you can finish in about ten hours the first time.
book.quicreate.skyblock.sky.intro.s1.p1:
The **soft ending** is killing the Ender Dragon, but the only stronghold is on the Moon, so you have to build a rocket to get there.

The **true ending** is crafting the creative factory parts, which needs a boss from every planet and a solid automated factory.
book.quicreate.skyblock.sky.intro.s1.p2: The three core mods are Ad Astra (space), Create: New Age (electricity and heat) and L_Ender's Cataclysm (bosses). Quicreate is the pack's own mod that ties them together.
book.quicreate.skyblock.sky.intro.s2.p0: Andesite alloy is charcoal plus andesite. Put it on a stripped log (axe it first) to make andesite casing.
book.quicreate.skyblock.sky.intro.s2.p1:
Shafts carry rotation and cogwheels change its direction and speed; together with casing they are the frame of every machine in the next chapter.

- [Andesite Alloy](entry://quicreate:skyblock/sky/andesitealloy)
- [Andesite Casing](entry://quicreate:skyblock/sky/andesite_casing)
- [Shafts & Cogwheels](entry://quicreate:skyblock/sky/shafts_cogs)
book.quicreate.skyblock.sky.intro.s2.tit: Andesite alloy and the first Create parts
book.quicreate.skyblock.sky.intro.tips.p:
- Your inventory is kept on death (it can be changed in the config).
- Vein mining with the **~** key (Ore Excavation) takes a whole tree and its leaves in one go.
- Sneaking next to a sapling makes it grow faster.

book.quicreate.skyblock.space.intro.over: Everything for the tier 1 rocket. Nearly every part is steel plate, so start by pressing a big batch. The suit keeps you alive on the Moon, the oxygen loader fills it, and the fuel refinery turns oil into rocket fuel.
The rocket is assembled in the **NASA Workbench** from a nose cone, fins, steel tanks and a steel engine, then placed on a launch pad.
book.quicreate.skyblock.space.intro.s0.p: You need the full suit: helmet, suit, pants and boots. Gas tanks hold oxygen; the large gas tank is a spare to refill the suit. The oxygen loader makes oxygen from water.
book.quicreate.skyblock.space.intro.s1.p: The rocket fan (steel rocket propeller) goes into the steel engine, which also needs an emerald circuit. Build the NASA workbench, assemble the rocket in it, and put down a launch pad.
book.quicreate.skyblock.space.intro.s2.p: Oil comes from rubber balls in a superheated mixer (rubber is from the waterlogged sifter, #32). The fuel refinery turns oil into rocket fuel.
book.quicreate.skyblock.space.intro.tips:
- Bring fuel for the trip home, or plan to make it on the Moon.
- Moon villages and towers also have suit parts, tanks and fuel in their chests, but don't count on it.

Venus & Mercury: start here

*Chapter 4 · Venus & Mercury*

Both planets are hot: wear the netherite space suit (or cursium armour) before you land. You need both of them for the tier 4 rocket.

**Venus** has calorite, the Ancient Factory (the Harbinger, who drops witherite) and the Fungal Forest.

**Mercury** is the only source of platinum, and has the Burning Arena (Ignis, ignitium) and the Soul Black Smith (the Netherite Monstrosity).
Venus and Mercury
Calorite ore is between Y −80 and 80. The Harbinger in the Ancient Factory drops a block of witherite; more witherite comes from netherite + calorite in a superheated mixer.
